channel.title: 7News · AI at work
channel.description: AI at work channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: LlamaIndex on KYC automation: document agents instead of manual review at scale
item.description: LlamaIndex KYC use-case post: five stages from intake to ongoing monitoring; document parsing as the underestimated bottleneck; not legal advice.

item.title: SenseTime launches Raccoon Finance across five lending-to-research scenarios
item.description: Raccoon Finance covers credit risk, claims, compliance, ops analytics, and research; release cites Ping An due diligence ~30 minutes and statement analysis ~4h→15m—partner/vendor figures.

item.title: LlamaIndex ships OCRia-1.5 for tables, charts, and forms
item.description: LlamaIndex: OCRia-1.5 is live in LlamaParse—4B for Agentic, new 2B for Cost Effective—with higher ParseBench-2 scores on tables, charts, forms, and visual grounding.

item.title: ChatGPT for Healthcare adds computer-use agents and 20+ plugins
item.description: OpenAI: stronger computer-use agents, trusted clinical search, and 20+ healthcare plugins for ChatGPT for Healthcare; 1,300+ physician reviews cited higher across eight dimensions; BAA and workspace settings required.

item.title: Cohere Compass previews Video Intelligence for timestamped search
item.description: Cohere: Compass Video Intelligence preview retrieves precise moments from meetings, training, and media—timestamped clips with transcript and visual description, indexed with documents.

item.title: SenseTime cites IDC No.1 share in China’s H1 2026 vision AI private market
item.description: SenseTime quotes IDC’s China AI software H1’26 tracker: vision private market up 16.8% to RMB 43.2B, SenseTime at 19.5% share; claims a decade atop related IDC rankings.

item.title: Azure Content Understanding adds GPT-5.6 / GPT-6 / GPT-6.1 with selection data
item.description: Foundry blog: Content Understanding gains GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1; start document extraction on GPT-6.1 Sol, with task-level evals and relative token cost.

item.title: SenseTime says Raccoon ranked in traffic and two Frost & Sullivan reports
item.description: SenseTime release: Raccoon cites AI Xinbang weekly traffic in China’s top three and Frost & Sullivan desktop-agent TOP3 plus analytics-agent Leaders #1—vendor-relayed third-party rankings.

item.title: Azure Content Understanding adds agentic mode (preview)
item.description: Microsoft Foundry’s Content Understanding agentic mode uses a document-native harness for hard multi-step tasks—while standard single-pass extraction still covers most schemas.

item.title: LlamaIndex ships OCRia-1, a 4B document-parsing VLM for LlamaParse
item.description: LlamaIndex introduces OCRia-1, a 4B VLM it calls state-of-the-art on ParseBench and table benchmarks, now powering LlamaParse with a focus on accuracy, cost, and latency.

item.title: AI in team docs: decide who owns the conclusion first
item.description: Before AI writes into shared docs, set conclusion ownership, citation rules, and human sign-off—or rework will eat the gains.
